result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon — only the text label is visible, creating an inconsistent and confusing navigation experience.

issues.description: The 'Orders' item in the bottom navigation bar has no icon visible, unlike the other tabs (Home, Search, Profile) which each show an icon above their label.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing icon above the 'Orders' label so all four bottom navigation tabs have a consistent icon-plus-label layout.
